description: Captures the deterministic transition from end-of-E1M1 (exit-switch trigger) to the intermission screen (WI_loadData / WI_Start / WI_initStats), including the IDM_TIMER_FRAMES counter, stats animation length, KILLS/ITEMS/SECRETS bar fill durations, and the framebuffer + state snapshots at intermission entry and exit tics. Entries empty pending external reference run.
captureMethod: Run scripted path from 02-019 spawn through E1M1 to the exit switch (use-line 11 or 52), capture state + framebuffer at the WI_INITIAL_PAUSE end tic, the per-stat-bar fill end tics, and the WI_NEXTLOC end tic before E1M2 starts loading.
